checks.question: Is generation ownership shared and accessed through injected/public storage contracts?
checks.detail: The owner exposes /storage and consumes a type-only StableValueStorage port; the inspected storage modules have no GM/Tauri/Node/app imports. All six internal production dependencies use workspace:*. No production graph or complete transitive dependency scan was performed.

checks.question: Are staging, corruption/restart, writer freeze and concurrent commits safe?
checks.detail: Existing tests exercise before/after-persistence failure at each write and reclamation step, stale snapshots, competing commits during staging, checksum failures and retained live chunks. Supplemental altered-part/manifest probes reject publication; poisoned ordinary writes perform no further generation IO; replacement freezes writes until reload. B06-S01 fails: a competing successful commit between the last check and unconditional pointer write is lost. The shared port has no atomic compare-and-publish operation.

checks.question: Are current-only initialization and host/namespace ownership preserved at this boundary?
checks.detail: Initialization reads only current product keys. Ordinary host library writes strip host tag/material joins and preserve tag/composer and unknown future namespaces; recording disablement also retains them. Unsupported namespace writers/readers reject without overwriting the opaque value. Unknown IDs have no generic named storage reader. Proxy secrets are separated in the existing shared test. Namespace retention is established; actual session projection withdrawal, plugin execution/registration, GM prefix and native credential storage are deferred.

checks.question: Do ordinary host track writes exclude transient data?
checks.detail: The tested unknown mediaUrl/mediaBytes/finalPath/password properties are excluded by ordinary library writes, and the proxy-secret isolation test passes. B06-S02 fails because artworkUrl uses optionalString with no stable-URL validation: a Blob URL survives ordinary save, generation load and restart. This is not an assertion that all host fields, opaque namespace contents, portable data or runtime credential paths have been accepted.

findings.owner: packages/music-workbench shared generation commit; runtime serialization must be traced in the separate GM/Tauri batches
findings.title: Non-atomic final pointer publication loses a successful competing update
findings.trigger: Two writers load generation G. Writer A finishes staging and its final raw.read sees G. Before A's raw.write(PRODUCT_COMMIT_KEY), writer B stages/publishes its theme update and returns success. A then unconditionally publishes its already computed snapshot.
findings.effect: Both writes return successfully. Reload follows A's pointer and loses B's previously successful update. The defect applies to any independent field in the overwritten snapshot; the probe uses a theme change to avoid assuming runtime behavior.
findings.suggestedNextAction: Add a real atomic compare-and-publish or a runtime-owned single-writer/serialization boundary covering validation and publication, with stale-conflict handling before acknowledging success. A second read alone leaves the same gap. Add a permanent interleaving regression when the fix is authorized.
findings.evidenceLimit: Deterministic shared-port interleaving, matching the existing staging-race test technique. Actual GM cross-tab and Tauri renderer/native scheduling have not been inspected or reproduced.

findings.title: Blob artwork URLs are persisted in the host library
findings.trigger: A schema-6 valid library track supplies artworkUrl='blob:https://any-music.invalid/audit-object-url-marker' and is saved using store.write('local-library:v1', library).
findings.effect: optionalString accepts the Blob URL unchanged; it remains in immutable generation core data and the reloaded snapshot. The persisted reference expires with its originating context and violates the explicit no-Blob-URL product contract.
findings.suggestedNextAction: Use stable-URL validation for persisted artwork metadata and omit/reject ephemeral Blob URLs. Keep ordinary stable artwork URLs and stable source identities. Add a permanent behavioral save/reload regression when the fix is authorized.
findings.evidenceLimit: Reproduced through the shared ordinary host save/reload path with synthetic valid metadata. No production source is claimed to emit this exact URL; portable preflight and other URL fields remain separate checks.
